title: Information Security Awareness, Education and Training for Cloud
description: Ensure strong identity verification mechanisms including multi-factor authentication (MFA) and least privilege are enforced across cloud administrative accounts.

title: Removal and Deletion of Cloud Service Customer Assets
description: Cloud customer data assets must support cryptographic erasure and customer-managed encryption lifecycle controls (e.g. IBM Key Protect CRKs).

title: Segregation in Virtual Computing Environments
description: Multi-tenant cloud resources and virtual computing environments must enforce strict logical segregation to prevent cross-tenant or unauthorized perimeter access.

title: Virtual Machine and Operating System Hardening
description: Virtual compute instances must be hardened by disabling unneeded network services, removing default ingress allowances, and shielding remote administrative ports (SSH/RDP).

title: Shared Resource Management in Cloud Services
description: Shared cloud storage and compute instances must maintain strict isolation parameters, object versioning, and access permission verification.

title: Information Security Event Logging for Cloud Services
description: Comprehensive audit logging of control-plane and administrative events must be captured, routed, archived to immutable storage, and actively monitored.

title: Protection of Cloud Network Environments and Boundaries
description: Network boundaries, security groups, and access control lists must prevent unauthorized exposure of internal cloud workloads and database tiers to public internet routing.
